description: This file contains shell script functions used to facilitate Git merge tool operations, including initialization, retrieving tool commands, and running merge tools. It is intended to be sourced by other scripts to set up merge-related functions.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Returns a merge tool, indicating if it was guessed via the return code.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Provides the custom command to invoke a specific merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the merge tool executable.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Sets up functions specific to the merge tool so they can be used or overridden.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Executes a merge tool with provided parameters.
